items.title: Blackstone Targets $3B Fund to Buy Real Estate Fund Stakes
items.summary: Blackstone seeks $3 billion to buy discounted stakes in real estate funds, targeting data centers, rental housing, and industrial assets.

items.title: Blackstone bets $1.5B on Pfizer’s obesity drug
items.summary: The deal will support a sprawling Phase 3 program for a monthly GLP-1 shot Pfizer acquired by winning a bidding war for the drug’s previous owner, Metsera.

items.title: Blackstone backs Pfizer’s obesity ambitions with $1.5bn fund
items.summary: Pfizer has an extensive clinical programme for berobenatide, acquired via its $10bn takeover of Metsera.

items.title: Blackstone Is Paying Up to $1.5 Billion for Pfizer’s Answer to Wegovy
items.summary: Pfizer just convinced Wall Street's biggest private investor to shoulder its obesity bet, yet the payoff for shareholders may not come from the drug at all. The real story sits in who keeps the upside and what arrives first.

items.title: Why Pfizer Is Tapping Private Equity to Back Its Once-Monthly Weight-Loss Drug
items.summary: Blackstone Life Sciences agrees to pay $1.5 billion in development costs for Pfizer’s berobenatide through 2028 in exchange for milestone-based payments.

items.title: What You Actually Own When You Buy Pershing Square Stock
items.summary: Bill Ackman's famous stock picks sit inside funds that Pershing Square shareholders don't actually own. What they hold instead is a fee-collecting machine with sticky capital, and one upcoming launch could decide whether that bet pays off.

items.title: Pfizer Secures Up to $1.5B Funding From Blackstone for Obesity Program
items.summary: PFE gets up to $1.5 billion from Blackstone to fund berobenatide's development through 2028, retaining full control of the obesity program.

items.title: Blackstone Courts Dubai’s Rich in Race to Tap $1 Trillion Market
items.summary: Blackstone Inc.’s top private wealth executives held their first-ever gathering in Dubai to court the city’s deep-pocketed investors, as the alternative asset manager seeks to expand its business across the Gulf.
